svg.title: ReLU gate under mean shift
svg.desc: As the mean of a unit-variance Gaussian preactivation shifts from negative to positive, the active probability and retained second moment differ; both equal one half only at zero mean.
svg.text: Z ~ Normal(b, 1) · shifting the preactivation mean
P(Z > 0) versus E[ReLU(Z)²] / E[Z²] · illustrative Gaussian.
